verdict.rationale: Bento is an email marketing SaaS that ships AI features (an AI builder, a hosted MCP server), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no policy, setting, or contractual commitment covering whether customer data is used to train AI models. The subscriber anonymization/deletion API is an adjacent data-deletion control, not a training opt-out, so it earns no credit.
